# Introduction

The *HTAN* package is a client for the open-access data of the Human Tumor
Atlas Network (HTAN), Phase 1. This vignette is a placeholder; a full
walk-through arrives with the user API.

# Installation

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("seandavi/HTAN")
```

```{r load}
library(HTAN)
```

# Session information

```{r sessionInfo}
sessionInfo()
```
